cases.preparationDecision: NEW exact whole-green-mung version. Preserve100g dry white jasmine rice,150g whole dried green mung (Vigna radiata),20g raw unsalted cashews,700ml water and two servings. Rinse rice and whole mung, then cook together in all700ml water under a lid until both are fully soft; serve all liquid, no guessed soaking/cooking loss or cooked-yield substitution. Do not claim25min total time suffices for whole dried mung. Warm all20g cashews in separately weighed14g pure ghee, retain all fat and nuts in the porridge. Pepper uses existing native TL2g measure; salt-to-taste remains, source-zero sentinel is not0g salt. Remove unrelated generic meat/filling instruction; no added meat or unquantified serving. Rice porridge80, two boiled-whole-mung study means31.43/42 and cashew22/27 are LOW preparation/food analogies, not measured mixed pongal or biological bounds.
